 Appearance:
Shri Sushil Kumar Jha - Advocate for appellants.

Shri Deepchand Gupta - Advocate for respondent No.3/Insura
 Order

This Miscellaneous Appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been preferred by the appellants/claimants seeking enhancement of the compensation awarded by the Learned Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Niwadi, District Tikamgarh, vide award dated 15/11/2014 passed in M.C.C. No. 23/2014.
2.

entities.text: Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Niwadi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for appellants/claimants submitted that the compensation awarded by the Tribunal amounting to Rs. 3,59,000/- is inadequate and not in accordance with the settled principles governing grant of just compensation.
It is further submitted that the income of the deceased has been assessed on the lower side and that the amounts awarded by the Tribunal is also insufficient.
In these circumstances, he orally prays before this Court for enhancement of Rs.50,000/-.

3. On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent No.3/Insurance Company supported the impugned award and submitted that NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-JBP:26366 2 MA-580-2015 the compensation awarded by the Tribunal is just and proper and does not warrant interference.
It is further submitted that this appeal is filed by appellants/claimants only for enhancing compensation amount Rs.30,000/-.
4. Having heard learned counsel appearing for the parties.

5. Upon perusal of the record, this Court finds that although the Tribunal has broadly applied the correct multiplier, the compensation awarded under conventional heads appears to be on the lower side.
In these circumstances of the case and in order to meet the ends of justice, this Court deems it appropriate to enhance the compensation by a sum amount of Rs.30,000/-.

Accordingly, the total compensation is enhanced from Rs.
3,59,000/- to Rs.3,89,000/-.

The enhanced amount of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only)
shall carry interest at the same rate as awarded by the Tribunal i.e. 6% per annum from the date of filing of this appeal till realization.
The liability to pay the enhanced compensation shall remain the same as fixed by the Tribunal.
7. With aforesaid direction, this miscellaneous appeal is disposed off.
8. Record of the Tribunal be sent back along with a copy of this order.

(RATNESH CHANDRA SINGH BISEN) JUDGE sp/-
